title: Heisenberg position-momentum relation
references: Heisenberg, W., Über den anschaulichen Inhalt der quantentheoretischen Kinematik und Mechanik, Zeitschrift für Physik 43(3-4), 172-198 (1927), doi:10.1007/BF01397280
Kennard, E. H., Zur Quantenmechanik einfacher Bewegungstypen, Zeitschrift für Physik 44, 326-352 (1927), doi:10.1007/BF01391200
Griffiths, D. J. and Schroeter, D. F., Introduction to Quantum Mechanics, 3rd ed., Cambridge University Press (2018)
validity_domain: Standard deviations dx and dp of position and momentum along the same axis, for any quantum state of a particle: dx * dp >= hbar / 2 (Kennard 1927). The law bounds dx from below for a given dp.
limitations: dx and dp are standard deviations over an ensemble of identically prepared systems, not the error of one measurement
The bound is for the same axis; different axes are independent
A lower bound on the product: real states, such as a non-Gaussian packet, have a larger product
The core checks no condition dp > 0 here, a non-positive dp is not meaningful and gives no verdict of its own
Not a statement about measurement disturbance (Ozawa and others show that is a different relation)

variables.dp: Standard deviation of the momentum along the axis
